newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Best Wide suspended shares trading.
newsitem.headline: Best Wide suspended shares trading.

text.p: Trading in shares of garment manufacturing and real estate concern Best Wide Group Ltd was suspended at the company's request pending an announcement, the stock exchange said on Thursday.
Best Wide shares ended unchanged at HK$0.56 each on Wednesday. The company said in a statement on Wednesday it had settled HK$4 million of debts with certain creditors.

Last month Best Wide's chairman and controlling shareholder Li Chun was negotiating with banks to restructure indebtedness, which would only involve his personal investments. Li would not sell his stake in the company to repay his debt.
Li held 51.5 percent of Best Wide as of August 6.
